name: Claude Mythos 5.2
traits: Same underlying model as Fable 5.2, without certain cyber or biology safeguards.
Communicates more clearly than past Mythos models.
Shows better judgment and calibration on the vulnerabilities it reports.

advice.value: the most ambitious, open-ended technical work
Claude Opus 5.5 for most coding and knowledge tasks

weakness: Suspects it is being evaluated more than recent models
resistance: Falls back to Opus 5 for some AI R&D topics

flavor.quote: Mythos 5.2 roughly doubled the vulnerability discovery metrics of Mythos 5.1 across respective scanning campaigns.

art_briefs: A towering figure woven from threads of pale blue light strides through a colossal fortress of stacked translucent walls at midnight, seen from a low angle. With one outstretched hand it pulls thin black fractures out of the stone like splinters, while its other palm seals each wound with molten amber. A few hidden cracks glow faintly ahead, waiting to be found. Deep indigo shadows, sharp amber highlights, one bold diagonal of the figure's stride cutting across the frame.

A serene giant with skin like polished mother-of-pearl kneels on a misty shoreline at dawn, assembling an enormous hollow sphere of interlocking coral and teal tiles that mirror one another in perfect symmetry. Its long arms lift the final glowing tile into place as overlapping fragments drift and click together around it. Soft pink morning light, cool sea-green shadows, viewed from slightly above so the faceted shell and the kneeling figure form one clear, rounded silhouette.

Seen from far behind, a slender figure of dark violet glass stands barefoot on the rim of a vast spinning disc of golden fire circling a perfectly black void. It holds a small orb of churning, boiling light high above its head in both hands, studying the instant the orb collapses inward. Streams of starlight bend around its body. Deep space blacks, searing gold and violet, a single strong vertical figure against the immense horizontal ring.

Viewed straight down from above, a broad-shouldered figure of brushed copper and frosted green glass crouches across a sprawling landscape of layered circuit terrain under harsh white noon light. One finger traces a glowing copper path between towering components while the other hand cradles a small finished handheld device. Around it, tiny two-armed robots solve a coloured puzzle cube and unscrew bottle caps. Bold geometric greens, warm copper lines, crisp hard shadows radiating from the central sprawling figure.
